text:
Maya (Design): dropped a fresh mock for Trace Viewer compact layout: https://figma.com/file/trace-viewer-compact - main goals: reduce horizontal real estate, keep correlation ID & quick-export visible on narrow screens :eyes:
Maya (Design): also changed a few labels: 'Trace details' -> 'Request & Trace', 'Download' -> 'Export trace' (thinking explicit format in submenu). feedback welcome.
Ethan (Eng): looks tidy. question: for narrow view, do we hide the timeline graph or make it collapsible? keyboard access important.
Maya (Design): plan: timeline collapses into a mini-sparkline that expands. the expand control is keyboard focusable and reports aria-expanded.
Noah (Accessibility): good call. ensure the mini sparkline has an accessible name like 'Request latency overview, 5 segments' and each segment gets an aria-label with ms and service.
Ethan (Eng): for frame lists I'm leaning to a single menu per frame (3-dot) to avoid tabbing through a bunch of inline buttons. will that meet the designers' needs?
Maya (Design): yes, primary action is the frame title to expand. three-dot menu for secondary actions: 'Open source', 'Copy frame link', 'Copy correlation id', 'Export frame'.
Priya (Product): export wording: please show format in the menu: 'Export trace (HAR)', 'Export trace (JSON)'. we want explicitness to reduce support tickets.
Noah (Accessibility): microcopy/accessibility notes: 1) change contrast for meta text from #6b7280 to #4b5563 for 12px 2) add 'Skip to frames' link at top of modal 3) chevrons must have aria-controls and aria-expanded.
Ethan (Eng): implementation notes: will make correlation chip a button with role=button, tabindex=0, aria-label='Copy correlation id <id>'. copying uses navigator.clipboard.writeText with fallback. toast is aria-live='polite'.
Maya (Design): I changed the copy for expand control to 'Expand frames (5)' when collapsed so count is explicit. is the parenthesis count okay?
Priya (Product): yes, Product likes explicit counts. also add a per-user last-export-format preference so we default to what they used last.
Ethan (Eng): backend note: current endpoint is /trace/:id/export. product docs want /trace/:id/download. we can add a lightweight alias on the docs but keep endpoint stable for now.
Noah (Accessibility): keyboard flow: tab order should be header -> skip link -> correlation chip -> timeline -> frames list -> export control. ensure focus ring is visible on high-contrast. also ensure all interactive targets are at least 44x44px.
Maya (Design): small copy tweaks: header 'Request & Trace', chip tooltip 'Copy ID', after action tooltip 'Copied!'. export split button with primary 'Export' and caret for formats.
Priya (Product): recording an A/B test: collapsed-by-default (for traces >6 frames) vs expanded. metric: median time to identify top error frame. will add ticket.
Ethan (Eng): I'll implement ARIA attributes, copy behavior, and the export split button. will add unit tests for aria-expanded states and keyboard menu focus.
ci-bot: Accessibility scan results posted: warnings - timestamp contrast, missing aria-expanded on sample chevrons. CI link: https://ci.internal/scan/1799
Maya (Design): thanks. I'll update Figma per Noah's suggestions and post keyboard screenshots. will re-request review once pushed.
